data.vector.yaml:
api:
  enabled: true
  address: 0.0.0.0:8686

data_dir: /vector-data-dir

sources:
  wazuh_alerts:
    type: file
    include:
      - /var/ossec/logs/alerts/alerts.json
    read_from: end
    ignore_not_found: true

transforms:
  parse_json:
    type: remap
    inputs: ["wazuh_alerts"]
    source: |
      . = parse_json!(.message)

sinks:
  opensearch_all:
    type: elasticsearch
    inputs: ["parse_json"]
    endpoints:
      - http://opensearch.platform-opensearch.svc.cluster.local:9200
    api_version: v7
    mode: bulk
    compression: gzip
    bulk:
      index: wazuh-alerts-%Y.%m.%d
    healthcheck: true
    request:
      timeout_secs: 30
      retry_attempts: 10
      retry_backoff_secs: 2
    batch:
      max_events: 1000
      timeout_secs: 1
